Buyer guideFinance & transfer

Know what the lender entry means.

Why a lender entry needs a follow-up

A finance entry tells you there is something to verify before transfer.

In this guide

01Understand the entry02Ask for closure documents03Confirm the transfer requirements
01

Understand the entry

Hypothecation records a lender’s interest in the vehicle. An active registration entry does not tell you the loan balance or whether payments are overdue.

02

Ask for closure documents

Discuss the current loan status with the seller and request the lender’s closure and no-objection documents where relevant.

03

Confirm the transfer requirements

Verify the current entry and the applicable removal and transfer requirements with the relevant official service before committing.

Take this question to the seller
“Do you have the lender’s closure documents?”

Use the available entry as a prompt to verify the current status before transfer.

See the records in context.Review the lender entry

Read the dated records, then check the original documents.
